scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR T_max40 eta_min0; step after epoch
pretraining: identical cached ImageNet MobileNetV2 prefix features[:11] in all variants
augmentation: RGB bilinear/mask nearest resize256, train horizontal flip p0.5; same epoch-derived order and flip stream
checkpoint_selection: maximum development validation global mIoU; earlier epoch wins exact tie

baseline_gate.reference_limitation: engineering anchor only; old A used different decoder and BCE-only loss, not an isolated truncation control

expansion_policy: two predefined factorial controls then freeze all structures; no further fit
limitations: development split has been seen in earlier work; not a pristine generalization test
S2->S3 jointly changes scale-consistent boundary generation and hard-to-soft targets; cannot isolate those two effects with four groups alone
new_branch: Only first-stage detail input L-Hup->L; output interface inherited from parent
initialization: Fresh task parameters plus original cached ImageNet weights; no task/smoke warmstart
